theme: Light mode by default (Financial Clarity). High-end, pristine, and authoritative. Toggle available for Dark mode (Obsidian Terminal).
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4) mixed with organic trust.

rtl_requirements.typography: High-quality Persian web fonts are mandatory.
rtl_requirements.alignment: Right-to-left optical alignment. All standard 'ml'/'mr' Tailwind classes MUST be replaced with 'ms'/'me' (margin-start/margin-end).

typography.guidelines: Do NOT use Inter. Use Vazirmatn for all Persian text. Use JetBrains Mono EXCLUSIVELY for exchange rates and calculator numbers to give an elite trading terminal aesthetic.

colors.guidelines: Use stark contrasts. The background is a tinted warm off-white (#F9F9F8) not pure white. Rate colors (Buy/Sell) use Forest Green and Terracotta/Burnt Orange for high visibility without looking like generic neon traffic lights.

public_page.structure: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero text takes col-span-full md:col-span-8. Exchange rates sit in rigid, high-density cards.
public_page.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 or p-12 on outer containers.

admin_dashboard.structure: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Strict hierarchy, functional density.
admin_dashboard.surface: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle borders. Max 8px border-radius (rounded-md).

rate_cards.style: Neumorphism (Tactile) variants without the heavy shadow. Use crisp 1px borders (border-black/5 or border-white/10). Flat background matching surface color.
rate_cards.interaction: Subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1) and slight shadow (shadow-sm) increase. No generic color overlays.

forms_and_calculator.style: Shadcn components heavily customized. Remove default Vercel look. Input fields should have solid backgrounds (bg-gray-50) and sharp borders. No generic transparent dropdowns.
forms_and_calculator.interaction: Focus states must be high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black).

navigation.style: Solid background or high-opacity Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) to ensure readability.

toasts.style: Minimalist, matching surface colors, placed at bottom-center or bottom-right.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle grain overlay on hero section to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use a slow, elegant marquee for conversion rates (e.g., USD to TRY, EUR to USD) running continuously below the hero.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for UI icons. Must use data-testid for all interactive icons.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for rate cards using framer-motion.
motion.interactive: Scale down 0.98 on active (click) states for buttons.
motion.guidelines: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do not use 'transition-all', specify transform and opacity.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first. All designs default to grid-cols-1.
responsive.layout: Stack bento grid into vertical lists on mobile. Ensure padding is comfortable (p-4 to p-6).
responsive.typography: Scale down massive headings. text-5xl on desktop becomes text-4xl on mobile.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-[100vw] and overflow-x-hidden on the main wrapper. Flex children should have min-w-0.
responsive.tap_targets: Min 44x44px for all buttons and inputs (calculator).
responsive.image_constraints: max-h-[60vh] on mobile for any visual header images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over Buy/Sell tags passes APCA/WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: Explicit focus rings on all inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='save-rates-button').

hero_background.description: Curved white architectural ribs. Use as a subtle hero background or bento box image overlay with heavy masking (bg-white/90) to create texture without distracting from rates.

admin_login_side.description: Low angle blue geometric curtain wall. Use for the split-screen admin login page (left or right side depending on RTL).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply `dir='rtl'` on the html/body tag.
Use Tailwind's logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, text-start, text-end) instead of physical ones (pl-, pr-).
Integrate 'Vazirmatn' as the primary font and apply it to the body. Use 'JetBrains Mono' specifically for currency amounts and timestamps to give it a terminal look.
Avoid Shadcn HTML `<input type='date'>`, `<select>` -> Use Shadcn React components instead.
Ensure the hero header is NOT transparent without a blur backdrop if content scrolls under.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'ذخیره تغییرات با موفقیت انجام شد').
Include an Exchange Calculator on the public page with Shadcn Select and Inputs.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` (e.g. data-testid='exchange-calc-submit').
Use Forest Green (#0B6E4F) for Buy (خرید) and Terracotta (#D95C14) for Sell (فروش). Avoid generic violet/purple entirely.
Ensure mobile-first styling: heavily pad desktop containers (p-8 to p-12) but constrain to p-4 on mobile viewports.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use 'transition: all', write explicit transition properties.
Do NOT center align the entire app container.
Create depth with layered elements and 1px crisp borders, not just shadows.
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use pre-existing UI components from src/components/ui/ before building custom.
Include data-testid on every button, link, and form input.
Files are .js (not .tsx) so ensure to output JSX valid in pure React/JS.
For toasts, use `sonner` located at `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (or adapt Shadcn standard setup for JS).
